integrity: Standalone standard-library checker verifies oriented edge counts through n=7, exact finite decomposition, and controlled numerical consequences; analytical proof required for the infinite L1 limit.
scientific_limitations: Independent uniform-permutation binary search trees on the same ordered key set only; matching *direct parent-child* labelled edges. No fluctuation theorem, correlated-priority extension, or claim of settled historical priority.
title: A zeta-density law for shared edges in independent random search trees
